claims.wording: The reviewed Cañada College 2020 inventory contains 69 records for the bounded Lot 1 and Building 9 investigation and its source context.
limits: The count includes summaries, context and subtotals; it is not a count of distinct defects or a campus-wide inventory.

claims.wording: The 2020 report priced four proposed curb-ramp assemblies at $23,500 in published estimates.
limits: The total is for the four proposed assemblies and excludes complete-route work and separate Building 9 approach records.
The estimates date to 2020. Current prices, work completion and present conditions remain unverified.

claims.wording: The historical survey leaves assessed crossing connections, distinct arrival and exterior endpoints, continuous route coverage and full repair scopes unresolved. The case supports an evidence inventory.
limits: The published map contains campus paths and historical crossing markings. The case has no assessed end-to-end graph for a comparison.

claims.wording: The independent source review completed M11. M1 through M10 remain open before a repair comparison can be supported.
limits: M11 establishes source-review acceptance for the inventory. The ten evidence requirements remain unresolved.

notApplicable.reason: The evidence does not support a connected, assessed case. No comparative computation was run and no benefit value is available.
